replication.target_description: Locator Table 7 actually reports hierarchical discipline/DEDLINE regressions for all 285 international manufacturers, with CUSTOM, VOLFLEX, MIXFLEX and TTM outcomes. Closest new-product-introduction analogue is TTM (time to market), Step 2 direct-discipline model; this is not a Dutch-only regression.

n.sample_role: Manufacturers with usable responses in the pooled 14-country Table 7 regressions, not the Dutch-only sample
n.exclusions: 474 manufacturers in database; 285 had usable responses for study. Table 1 includes only 8 Netherlands firms in pooled sample.
n.location: p. 940 (PDF p. 9), Table 7 title; p. 936, Methods sample
n.quote: Results of hierarchical regression analyses for flexibility performance on DISCIPLINE and DEDLINE (n = 285)

p.location: p. 940, Table 7, TTM Step 2: neither omnibus model p nor exact p for discipline/F-change printed; 3.047 has no significance star

reported_success.location: No narrative verdict for the supplied Dutch-only new-product-introduction target; Table 7 concerns pooled-country flexibility measures.

notes: Published article copy: online 2005; Journal of Operations Management 24 (2006), 932–947. Table 7 numerics visually verified on rendered primary PDF p. 9. Target mismatch is substantive: no Dutch-only analysis or outcome named new product introduction in Table 7. The closest pooled-country TTM Step 2 statistics are explicitly labelled as such; they do not verify a Dutch target. Step 2 is the direct-discipline model before moderator terms. The printed Step 2 R2 (.037) is the full model variance explained; no R2 increment was computed. Step 3 R2 is .048, with discipline coefficient .237*; its p < .05 is a different test and is not assigned to Step 2. Authors report support for Hypothesis 2 across CUSTOM, VOLFLEX and MIXFLEX; no Dutch-specific verdict can be extracted.
